Speechcraft — Privacy Policy

Speechcraft is a speech, acting and dialect trainer. It has no accounts and no servers of its own. This is the same policy shown inside the app under More → Privacy & Data, where you can also see everything stored on your device and delete it.

Privacy policy

Effective 22 September 2026.

What we collect: nothing. Speechcraft has no accounts, no servers of its own, and no analytics or advertising. The app never sends what you do in it anywhere.

Hosting: the app’s files are served by GitHub Pages. Like any web host, GitHub receives standard request details, such as your IP address, when your browser downloads them. GitHub’s own privacy statement covers that; Speechcraft adds nothing to it.

Cookies and storage: Speechcraft sets no cookies. It uses your browser’s own storage (local storage, IndexedDB and an offline cache) only to run the app: your progress, your projects and offline use. None of it is used for tracking or advertising, which is why the app never asks for cookie consent.

Feedback: reporting a problem takes you to GitHub Issues, a separate site with its own terms and privacy statement. Anything you post there is public.

Children: Speechcraft collects no personal information from anyone, including children.

Your rights: because your data never reaches us, there is nothing on our side to access, correct or delete. You control all of it on this device, and you can delete any of it at any time.

Changes: if this policy changes, the date above changes with it. Questions go through the Feedback page.

Questions go through the Feedback page in the app, which opens the project’s GitHub Issues.
